text: Warm up easy. Settle into your rhythm.
Pick it up. Strong and quick for one minute.
Recover and stay smooth. You have this.
Go again. Light feet and steady effort.
Ease back. Breathe deep and reset.
Push the pace. Stay tall and controlled.
Recover here. Smooth rhythm and relaxed shoulders.
Turn it up. Strong effort for sixty-five seconds.
Back to steady. Find your breath and keep moving.
Another push. Stay focused and drive forward.
Recover with purpose. Smooth and steady.
Pick it up again. Quick feet and strong form.
Settle back in. Control your breathing.
One minute push. Make it crisp and confident.
Recover now. Stay loose and keep the rhythm.
Final fast interval. Finish this one strong.
Cooldown. Ease the effort and celebrate the work.
